_note: Reference shape. Create the tool in the ElevenAgents dashboard (Tools > Webhook), then `pull` with the CLI and compare field names. Replace <WORKER_URL> and attach the TOOL_SECRET secret as the X-Tool-Secret header.
name: get_order_status
description: Look up the shipping status of one order. Call only after the customer has confirmed the order ID you read back.

order_id.description: 8-digit order ID, digits only, no spaces or dashes. Convert spoken Chinese numerals to digits.

phone_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the phone number on the order, digits only.
